scope: Six admitted lessons from the six verified episodes: four single-episode cases and both independent recoveries. Candidate episodes and identity prechecks were not adjudicated here.
method: Read every statement, applies_when, limitation, identifier and quote against projected evidence and the complete synthetic trace, then compare to the same-episode rule baseline. Mechanical reference checks supplement but do not determine the semantic verdict. No model or provider request was made for this review.

summary.assessment: No blocking semantic error in these six synthetic lessons. Added value is primarily more precise applicability, scoped verification and clearer retrieval keys; all technical actions were already present in the rule baseline. Two verified episodes remain conservative warning/inferred claims, so six admitted lessons must not be reported as six confirmed recoveries. This small selected synthetic sample does not establish production readiness or generalization.

limitations: A targeted passing check proves only the observed recovery/check relationship at the stated scope, not root cause or universal effectiveness.
Claims saying no broader tests were run are checked against the complete supplied synthetic trace; omission from a projected real trace alone would support not evidenced rather than never run.
Case annotations are evaluation guidance and were not treated as facts unavailable in the evidence.
No production memories, model requests, source modules or raw reports were modified.

manual_assessment.factual_support: The cited failed invocation and assertion identify the authentication test and expired-token failure. The recovery change_summary supports adding check_expiry(token); the cited same-target rerun supports exactly one targeted passing test. The lesson does not invent token lookup internals hidden by redaction.
manual_assessment.causality_and_scope: Confirmed status is restricted to the observed edit-to-check relationship. Both limitations explicitly reject broader coverage and an established root cause.
manual_assessment.applicability: Names the actual test, file, assertion, and edit. The condition partly describes the already-completed edit, so it is a bounded retrieval description rather than a general prospective rule.
manual_assessment.incremental_utility_vs_same_episode_rule: Clearer targeted applicability and test count than the rule baseline, with a shorter domain-specific semantic key; no new technical mechanism or transferable strategy beyond the baseline facts.
nonblocking_notes: The semantic key contains fix, but the natural-language claim explicitly limits this to an observed passing rerun; it does not assert universal repair.

The phrase linking check_expiry(token) as the cause of the original failure is awkward because this was the added action; better wording would distinguish the repair mechanism from the original cause. This does not introduce a false positive causal conclusion.
